title: AEGIS: Preserving Privacy of 3D Facial Avatars with Adversarial Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2511.17747v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The growing adoption of photorealistic 3D facial avatars, particularly those utilizing efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting representations, introduces new risks of online identity theft, especially in systems that rely on biometric authentication. While effective adversarial masking methods have been developed for 2D images, a significant gap remains in achieving robust, viewpoint-consistent identity protection for dynamic 3D avatars. To address this, we present AEGIS, the first privacy-preserving identity masking framework for 3D Gaussian avatars, concealing identity from automated face recognition while preserving the avatar's perceptual realism and animation usability. AEGIS applies adversarial perturbations to the base (DC) color coefficients of the Gaussian primitives, guided by an ensemble of pre-trained face verification networks, embedding the protection directly in the 3D representation so that it applies across viewpoints

translated_title: AEGIS：利用对抗性扰动保护3D面部虚拟形象的隐私
translated_abstract: 随着照片级逼真3D面部虚拟形象的日益普及，尤其是采用高效3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）表示的虚拟形象，带来了新的网络身份盗用风险，特别是在依赖生物特征认证的系统中。虽然针对2D图像已开发出有效的对抗性掩蔽方法，但在为动态3D虚拟形象实现鲁棒的、视角一致的身份保护方面仍存在显著空白。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AEGIS，这是首个面向3D高斯虚拟形象的隐私保护身份掩蔽框架，能够在保持虚拟形象感知真实感和动画可用性的同时，使其身份对自动人脸识别系统隐藏。AEGIS在预训练人脸验证网络集合的引导下，对高斯基元的基色（DC）系数施加对抗性扰动，将保护直接嵌入到3D表示中，从而使保护在各视角下均能生效。
tldr: AEGIS是首个针对3D高斯虚拟形象的隐私保护身份掩蔽框架，通过对高斯基元颜色系数施加对抗性扰动，在保持虚拟形象真实感和动画可用性的同时，实现跨视角一致的人脸识别身份保护。
en_tdlr: AEGIS is the first privacy-preserving identity masking framework for 3D Gaussian avatars, which embeds adversarial perturbations into the color coefficients of Gaussian primitives to achieve viewpoint-consistent identity protection from automated face recognition while preserving the avatar's perceptual realism and animation usability.
